title: FishShapes v1 specimens, slimmed to the features sim-engine/validate compares

source.cite: Price SA, Friedman ST, Corn KA, et al. 2022. FishShapes v1: functionally relevant measurements of teleost shape and size on three dimensions. Ecology 103:e3829

units: SL, depth, width and peduncle in metres (CSV mm / 1000); mass in kg (CSV g / 1000). Max_body_depth and Max_fish_width are maxima; peduncle values are minima.
aves: FishShapes is teleosts only; an Aves filter on Order/Family ran anyway and dropped 0 rows.
rows: Program Sepbop; Vessel Anton Bruun; Acc. 289275
